title: Demo QA: a stylesheet WordPress prints inline with its sourceURL is still that stylesheet, and the business's copyright line is not template text
steps: S1: With a Chrome answering on CDP, from the TCH checkout run with DEMO_QA_CDP set to that endpoint: node --test apps/tracy-host/test/demo-qa.test.mjs apps/tracy-host/test/demo-qa-browser.test.mjs
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the two tests named below.
expect: 0 failures; the browser test is not skipped.

A sheet read as <link> in the baseline and as an inline <style> ending in /*# sourceURL=<its url>?ver=… */ after passes css-intact and look-kept; the same block with a rule cut fails css-intact; a media="print" block reads as no longer loaded.
'Copyright © 2026 <name>. All Rights Reserved.' passes no-demo-words when <name> is in the brief as whole words; a template holder, or a name only inside a longer word of the brief, fails.
evidence: Dev WO build of a JA Restaurant WP site (22/10/2026): css-intact reported wp-includes/blocks/navigation/style.min.css 'no longer loaded' (inlined by WordPress after the agent's turn) and no-demo-words flagged the business's copyright line.
fence: The page reader's stylesheet list and the judge's copyright-holder rule

tests: no-demo-words: a copyright line is the brief’s when its holder is the brief’s name; the template’s holder still fails
css-intact and look-kept: a stylesheet WordPress moved from <link> to an inline <style> with its sourceURL is still that stylesheet; a print-only block is not
